hero.description: I redesigned the Nasdaq Data Link product page to simplify complex financial dataset offerings. By introducing a single-page layout with a dynamic pricing component and clearer product details, we improved user trust, boosted self-serve checkouts, and reduced support requests.
metadata: Focus: Launch landing page for new dataset

sections.text: The original product page was fragmented and hard to navigate. Key information like pricing and documentation was buried across tabs, leading to user frustration, low conversion rates and an increase in support tickets.

visual.caption: Some sketches I created during my exploration phase
visual.alt: Annotated research of the orginal Data Link product page

sections.text: I audited the existing experience, analyzed support tickets and mapped the user journey to surface friction points. Interviews with users and internal teams revealed blockers around pricing clarity, content visibility and trust. These insights shaped early concepts and aligned stakeholders around key priorities.
